description: Inputs of the v5 leaderboard (evals/v5_board.py). One entry per measured configuration; the board groups them by model and shows each model's best. Files are verbatim copies of run_eval results (and the reference ledger) in this directory; evals/results/ itself is not tracked. Each run names its exact weights with weights_id, an entry of weights.json; the board groups by (model, weights), so two quantizations of one model are two rows.
